description: Source code for WAN interface management, including starting, stopping, activating, and deactivating WAN interface state machines.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartWanVISM
methods.description: Starts the virtual interface state machine for a specified WAN interface, configuring all enabled virtual interfaces.

methods.name: WanMgr_StopWanVISM
methods.description: Stops the virtual interface state machine for a specified WAN interface, setting its selection status to not selected.

methods.name: WanMgr_ActivateInterface
methods.description: Activates a specified WAN interface if it is not already active, configuring routing and other settings.

methods.name: WanMgr_DeactivateInterface
methods.description: Deactivates a specified WAN interface, reverting it to standby state and removing configurations.
